mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_name AS toolName, description, parameters, method, url_template AS urlTemplate, body_template AS bodyTemplate, headers, credential_id AS credentialId, extract_path AS extractPath, max_response_bytes AS maxResponseBytes, timeout_millis AS timeoutMillis, enabled, status, version_no AS versionNo, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM http_tool_config

SELECT id, tool_name AS toolName, description, parameters, method, url_template AS urlTemplate, body_template AS bodyTemplate, headers, credential_id AS credentialId, extract_path AS extractPath, max_response_bytes AS maxResponseBytes, timeout_millis AS timeoutMillis, enabled, status, version_no AS versionNo, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM http_tool_config WHERE tool_name = #{toolName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO http_tool_config (tool_name, description, parameters, method, url_template, body_template, headers, credential_id, extract_path, max_response_bytes, timeout_millis, enabled) VALUES (#{toolName}, #{description}, #{parameters}, #{method}, #{urlTemplate}, #{bodyTemplate}, #{headers}, #{credentialId}, #{extractPath}, #{maxResponseBytes}, #{timeoutMillis}, #{enabled})
